text: answer[deal-3100875f]: The check passes when each frame’s signature verifies against the expected signer and transcript context, frames are processed in their required order, and folding their authenticated payloads produces exactly the claimed final value. Reject the result if any signature is invalid, a frame is missing, duplicated, reordered, associated with the wrong predecessor, or contains metadata outside the signed bytes. The verifier should compare the independently computed fold with the claimed value using an exact, unambiguous representation.
